description: The agent must: (1) Read all four reference files (graduation-and-planning-rules.md, course-catalog.md, required-bands-by-grade.md, summer-school-catalog.md) to establish the rule baseline — course codes must come only from the catalog. (2) Read the student transcript to identify Alex's completed Grade 9/10 courses, the two summer online credits (CHV2O, GLC2O) that already satisfy the 2-credit online requirement, and the 15/40 community hours. (3) Read the admin memo (catalog_update_aug2024.md) noting that ICS3U is removed from the in-school timetable and is now online-only — this must be reflected in the plan with a before/after diff. (4) Derive prerequisites for Waterloo CS (MHF4U, MCV4U, ENG4U, ICS3U→ICS4U) and McMaster Engineering (MHF4U or MCV4U, SCH4U or SPH4U, ENG4U), and produce Top 6 options for each. (5) Schedule Grade 11 and 12 under the protect_11_12 priority (avoid stacking heavy U-level courses), using summer school ONLY for non-Top6/non-4U courses (summerSchool.useFor=nonTop6 — the summer catalog has NO 4U/4M courses anyway, which must be respected). (6) Apply the standardized 4-section output: Targets & Assumptions, Prerequisites + Top 6 (with two composition options per target), 4-year plan by grade with cumulative credits (total/compulsory/elective), and Validation Checklist. (7) Save the result as alex_chen_plan.md. Key proprietary traps: (a) Course codes must match the catalog exactly (e.g., TTJ2O not TTJ1O for Grade 10 per memo); (b) ICS3U must be scheduled as online-only after the memo; (c) No 4U/4M course may appear in a summer school slot; (d) Cumulative credits must be tracked per the 17-compulsory/13-elective split; (e) The 2 online credits from summer are already satisfied and must be noted.
